verses.en: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
verses.pt: Depois que cessou o alvoroço, Paulo mandou chamar os discípulos e, tendo-os exortado, despediu-se e partiu para a Macedônia.
verses.en_web: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
verses.en_bbe: And after the noise had come to an end, Paul, having sent for the disciples and given them comfort, went away from them to Macedonia.

verses.en: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
verses.pt: E, havendo andado por aquelas regiões, exortando os discípulos com muitas palavras, veio à Grécia.
verses.en_web: When he had gone through those parts, and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had gone through those parts and given them much teaching, he came into Greece.

verses.en: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
verses.pt: Depois de passar ali três meses, visto terem os judeus armado uma cilada contra ele quando ia embarcar para a Síria, determinou voltar pela Macedônia.
verses.en_web: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had been there three months, because the Jews had made a secret design against him when he was about to take ship for Syria, he made a decision to go back through Macedonia.

verses.en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.pt: Acompanhou-o Sópater de Beréia, filho de Pirro; bem como dos de Tessalônica, Aristarco e Segundo; Gaio de Derbe e Timóteo; e dos da Ásia, Tíquico e Trófimo.
verses.en_web: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe; Timothy; and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
verses.en_bbe: And Sopater of Beroea, the son of Pyrrhus, and Aristarchus and Secundus of Thessalonica, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia, went with him as far as Asia.

verses.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
verses.pt: Estes porém, foram adiante e nos esperavam em Trôade.
verses.en_web: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
verses.en_bbe: But these had gone before, and were waiting for us at Troas.

verses.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
verses.pt: E nós, depois dos dias dos pães ázimos, navegamos de Filipos, e em cinco dias fomos ter com eles em Trôade, onde nos detivemos sete dias.
verses.en_web: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And we went away from Philippi by ship after the days of unleavened bread, and came to them at Troas in five days; and we were there for seven days.

verses.en: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.pt: No primeiro dia da semana, tendo-nos reunido a fim de partir o pão, Paulo, que havia de sair no dia seguinte, falava com eles, e prolongou o seu discurso até a meia-noite.
verses.en_web: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day, and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.en_bbe: And on the first day of the week, when we had come together for the holy meal, Paul gave them a talk, for it was his purpose to go away on the day after; and he went on talking till after the middle of the night.

verses.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
verses.pt: Ora, havia muitas luzes no cenáculo onde estávamos reunidos.
verses.en_web: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
verses.en_bbe: And there were a number of lights in the room where we had come together.

verses.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
verses.pt: E certo jovem, por nome åutico, que estava sentado na janela, tomado de um sono profundo enquanto Paulo prolongava ainda mais o seu sermão, vencido pelo sono caiu do terceiro andar abaixo, e foi levantado morto.
verses.en_web: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor, and was taken up dead.
verses.en_bbe: And a certain young man named Eutychus, who was seated in the window, went into a deep sleep; and while Paul went on talking, being overcome by sleep, he had a fall from the third floor, and was taken up dead.

verses.en: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
verses.pt: Tendo Paulo descido, debruçou-se sobre ele e, abraçando-o, disse: Não vos perturbeis, pois a sua alma está nele.
verses.en_web: Paul went down, and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
verses.en_bbe: And Paul went down and, falling on him, took him in his arms and said, Do not be troubled, for his life is in him.

verses.en: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
verses.pt: Então subiu, e tendo partido o pão e comido, ainda lhes falou largamente até o romper do dia; e assim partiu.
verses.en_web: When he had gone up, and had broken bread, and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had gone up, and had taken the broken bread, he went on talking to them for a long time, even till dawn, and then he went away.

verses.en: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.pt: E levaram vivo o jovem e ficaram muito consolados.
verses.en_web: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
verses.en_bbe: And they took the boy in, living, and were greatly comforted.

verses.en: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
verses.pt: Nós, porém, tomando a dianteira e embarcando, navegamos para Assôs, onde devíamos receber a Paulo, porque ele, havendo de ir por terra, assim o ordenara.
verses.en_web: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
verses.en_bbe: But we, going before him by ship, went to Assos with the purpose of taking Paul in there: for so he had given orders, because he himself was coming by land.

verses.en: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
verses.pt: E, logo que nos alcançou em Assôs, recebemo-lo a bordo e fomos a Mitilene;
verses.en_web: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard, and came to Mitylene.
verses.en_bbe: And when he came up with us at Assos, we took him in the ship and went on to Mitylene.

verses.en: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
verses.pt: e navegando dali, chegamos no dia imediato defronte de Quios, no outro aportamos a Samos e [e tendo-nos demorado em Trogílio, chegamos,] no dia seguinte a Mileto.
verses.en_web: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
verses.en_bbe: And going from there by sea, we came on the day after opposite Chios, and touching at Samos on the day after that, we came on the third day to Miletus.

verses.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.pt: Porque Paulo havia determinado passar ao largo de Éfeso, para não se demorar na Ásia; pois se apressava para estar em Jerusalém no dia de Pentecostes, se lhe fosse possível.
verses.en_web: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
verses.en_bbe: For Paul's purpose was to go past Ephesus, so that he might not be kept in Asia; for he was going quickly, in order, if possible, to be at Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

verses.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
verses.pt: De Mileto mandou a Éfeso chamar os anciãos da igreja.
verses.en_web: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus for the rulers of the church.

verses.en: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
verses.pt: E, tendo eles chegado, disse-lhes: Vós bem sabeis de que modo me tenho portado entre vós sempre, desde o primeiro dia em que entrei na Ásia,
verses.en_web: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
verses.en_bbe: And when they had come, he said to them, You yourselves have seen what my life has been like all the time from the day when I first came into Asia,

verses.en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
verses.pt: servindo ao Senhor com toda a humildade, e com lágrimas e provações que pelas ciladas dos judeus me sobrevieram;
verses.en_web: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
verses.en_bbe: Doing the Lord's work without pride, through all the sorrow and troubles which came on me because of the evil designs of the Jews:

verses.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
verses.pt: como não me esquivei de vos anunciar coisa alguma que útil seja, ensinando-vos publicamente e de casa em casa,
verses.en_web: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
verses.en_bbe: And how I kept back nothing which might be of profit to you, teaching you publicly and privately,

verses.en: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: testificando, tanto a judeus como a gregos, o arrependimento para com Deus e a fé em nosso Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Preaching to Jews and to Greeks the need for a turning of the heart to God, and faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
verses.pt: Agora, eis que eu, constrangido no meu espírito, vou a Jerusalém, não sabendo o que ali acontecerá,
verses.en_web: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
verses.en_bbe: And now, as you see, I am going to Jerusalem, a prisoner in spirit, having no knowledge of what will come to me there:

verses.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
verses.pt: senão o que o Espírito Santo me testifica, de cidade em cidade, dizendo que me esperam prisões e tribulações.
verses.en_web: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
verses.en_bbe: Only that the Holy Spirit makes clear to me in every town that prison and pains are waiting for me.

verses.en: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.pt: mas em nada tenho a minha vida como preciosa para mim, contando que complete a minha carreira e o ministério que recebi do Senhor Jesus, para dar testemunho do evangelho da graça de Deus.
verses.en_web: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
verses.en_bbe: But I put no value on my life, if only at the end of it I may see the work complete which was given to me by the Lord Jesus, to be a witness of the good news of the grace of God.

verses.en: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
verses.pt: E eis agora, sei que nenhum de vós, por entre os quais passei pregando o reino de Deus, jamais tornará a ver o meu rosto.
verses.en_web: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
verses.en_bbe: And now I am conscious that you, among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom, will not see my face again.

verses.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
verses.pt: Portanto, no dia de hoje, vos protesto que estou limpo do sangue de todos.
verses.en_web: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
verses.en_bbe: And so I say to you this day that I am clean from the blood of all men.

verses.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
verses.pt: Porque não me esquivei de vos anunciar todo o conselho de Deus.
verses.en_web: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
verses.en_bbe: For I have not kept back from you anything of the purpose of God.

verses.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
verses.pt: Cuidai pois de vós mesmos e de todo o rebanho sobre o qual o Espírito Santo vos constituiu bispos, para apascentardes a igreja de Deus, que ele adquiriu com seu próprio sangue.
verses.en_web: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention to yourselves, and to all the flock which the Holy Spirit has given into your care, to give food to the church of God, for which he gave his blood.

verses.en: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.pt: Eu sei que depois da minha partida entrarão no meio de vós lobos cruéis que não pouparão rebanho,
verses.en_web: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.en_bbe: I am conscious that after I am gone, evil wolves will come in among you, doing damage to the flock;

verses.en: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
verses.pt: e que dentre vós mesmos se levantarão homens, falando coisas perversas para atrair os discípulos após si.
verses.en_web: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
verses.en_bbe: And from among yourselves will come men who will give wrong teaching, turning away the disciples after them.

verses.en: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
verses.pt: Portanto vigiai, lembrando-vos de que por três anos não cessei noite e dia de admoestar com lágrimas a cada um de vós.
verses.en_web: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
verses.en_bbe: So keep watch, having in mind that for three years without resting I was teaching every one of you, day and night, with weeping.

verses.en: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verses.pt: Agora pois, vos encomendo a Deus e à palavra da sua graça, àquele que é poderoso para vos edificar e dar herança entre todos os que são santificados.
verses.en_web: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up, and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.en_bbe: And now, I give you into the care of God and the word of his grace, which is able to make you strong and to give you your heritage among all the saints.

verses.en: I have coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel.
verses.pt: De ninguém cobicei prata, nem ouro, nem vestes.
verses.en_web: I coveted no one’s silver, or gold, or clothing.
verses.en_bbe: I have had no desire for any man's silver or gold or clothing.

verses.en: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
verses.pt: Vós mesmos sabeis que estas mãos proveram as minhas necessidades e as dos que estavam comigo.
verses.en_web: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
verses.en_bbe: You yourselves have seen that with these hands I got what was necessary for me and those who were with me.

verses.en: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.pt: Em tudo vos dei o exemplo de que assim trabalhando, é necessário socorrer os enfermos, recordando as palavras do Senhor Jesus, porquanto ele mesmo disse: Coisa mais bem-aventurada é dar do que receber.
verses.en_web: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
verses.en_bbe: In all things I was an example to you of how, in your lives, you are to give help to the feeble, and keep in memory the words of the Lord Jesus, how he himself said, There is a greater blessing in giving than in getting.

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
verses.pt: Havendo dito isto, pôs-se de joelhos, e orou com todos eles.
verses.en_web: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
verses.en_bbe: And having said these words, he went down on his knees in prayer with them all.

verses.en: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul’s neck, and kissed him,
verses.pt: E levantou-se um grande pranto entre todos, e lançando-se ao pescoço de Paulo, beijavam-no.
verses.en_web: They all wept a lot, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
verses.en_bbe: And they were all weeping, falling on Paul's neck and kissing him,

verses.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
verses.pt: entristecendo-se principalmente pela palavra que dissera, que não veriam mais o seu rosto. E eles o acompanharam até o navio.
verses.en_web: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.
verses.en_bbe: Being sad most of all because he had said that they would not see his face again. And so they went with him to the ship.
